notes.title: Summoner’s Gambit Playtest Wrap-Up & Demo Launching September 26!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]First of all, we want to give our deepest thanks to all the players who joined the Summoner’s Gambit Playtest.[/p][p]As of today, the Playtest has officially come to a close. Your feedback and suggestions have been truly invaluable in helping us polish the game, and we are incredibly grateful for all the enthusiasm and support you’ve shown during this period.[/p][p]We are also thrilled to announce that the [b]Summoner’s Gambit Demo[/b] will be launching on Steam this Friday, September 26! Everyone will be able to download it and dive into the unique mix of strategic card play and auto-battler mechanics.[/p][p]Once again, thank you so much for playing, sharing your thoughts, and being part of this journey with us. We can’t wait to see you all again in the Demo on September 26![/p]

notes.title: Summoner's Gambit Playtest Update & gamescom 2025 Hands-On!
notes.content: [p][b]GAMESCOM 2025 LIVE DEMO[/b] [/p][p][i]Summoner's Gambit[/i] has descended upon gamescom 2025! [/p][p]🔥 Wager limbs and SANITY at [i]Hall 10.1, Stand A-042[/i] for exclusive hands-on trials![/p][p][/p][p][b]On-site rituals:[/b] [/p][p]🃏 Forge madness-driven decks to battle unspeakable horrors! [/p][p]⚡ Command legions born of primordial chaos! [/p][p]🌌 [i]"Trapped in the abyss? Shatter it with your strategy!"[/i] [/p][p]❓ [i]"What will your final move be?"[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW PLAYTEST CALLING ALL STRATEGISTS![/b] [/p][p]Join the [i]Summoner's Gambit[/i] revamped Playtest on Steam NOW![/p][p][/p][p]A heartfelt thank you to all players who participated in the test! Based on your feedback, we’ve released a new Playtest version. Both new and existing players are sincerely invited to experience the updated content and actively submit your opinions—every piece of your feedback will directly help optimize the game![/p][p][/p][p]Currently, the game is still in development, and the test remains a small-scale closed one. It is expected to take about a month to prepare for this, so please stay patient![/p][p][/p][p]🔹 Map Visual & Spawn Logic Overhaul[/p][p]-Full art style upgrade with enhanced terrain detailing and dynamic lighting[/p][p]-Intelligent resource spawn mechanics for refreshed exploration experience[/p][p]🔹 New Dynamic Event System[/p][p]-Randomly triggered exploration quests and resource competitions[/p][p]-Unique adventure guaranteed per playthrough[/p][p]🔹 Boss Encounter: Active Skill Injection[/p][p]-Players acquire random active skills during boss fights[/p][p]-Significantly deepened combat tactics[/p][p]🔹 Hotfixes & Optimizations[/p][p]-Smoothed difficulty scaling in specific levels[/p][p]-Stability improvements & performance optimizations[/p][p][/p][p][b]Final transmission:[/b][/p][p]⏳ WISHLIST ON STEAM!!![/p][p]⚔️ FACE THE OLD GODS[/p]

notes.title: Whispers of the Old Gods: Summoner’s Gambit Has Awakened
notes.content: [p]We are super excited to unveil Summoner’s Gambit — a bold fusion of strategic cardplay and tactical auto-battler elements, set in a dark realm ruled by ancient beings. Summoner’s Gambit isn’t just about winning, it’s about how you build, adapt, and survive in ever-changing battles. Each choice you make reshapes the battlefield. Each round is a gambit.[/p][p][/p][p]As an apostle of the Old Gods, your path is one of power, sacrifice, and calculated chaos:[/p][list][*][p]Forge a Chaotic Deck: Collect cards sealed with ancient creatures. Position them wisely to control attack order, trigger tactical synergies, and outplay your foes.[/p][/*][*][p]Bend the Energy Laws: Summoning comes at a cost. Avoid overflow backlash—or weaponize it as a turning point in battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Fuse Across Factions: Four ancient factions, endless combinations. Cross-breed creatures to create hybrids with dual-race abilities that can turn the tide.[/p][/*][*][p]Face Off in Asynchronous Duels: Venture through single-player boss fights or battle other summoners in high-stakes, turn-based duels.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This game is a love letter to players who crave deep mechanics, unpredictable outcomes, and the thrill of adapting on the fly. We’ve blended elements from roguelikes, deck-builders, and auto-battlers to create a combat system that rewards experimentation and foresight. Hope you enjoy the game and have fun out there.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]First Public Demo at G - FUSION Beijing 2025[/h2][p]We are thrilled to announce that Summoner’s Gambit will make its first-ever public demo appearance at FUSION Beijing 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]Date: June 28–29, 2025[/p][p]Venue: ShouGang International Convention Center (Halls 1 & 2), Beijing[/p][p]Booth: TapTap × Indie Game Zone – D27[/p][p][/p][p]Step into the arena. Show the Old Gods what you are made of.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Join the Community[/h2][p]Follow Summoner’s Gambit on X (Twitter) and YouTube for updates, and don’t forget to wishlist us on Steam to be the first to hear when the gods whisper again.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your support. Madness begins now.[/p][p][/p][p]X：[url="https://x.com/summoner_gambit"]https://x.com/summoner_gambit[/url][/p][p]Youtube：[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCZ-JPhj09zcZFXslD174SQw"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
